title: hotfix: enforce SLO circuit breaker + graceful regional failover under sustained high load
author: Ava Thompson
description: Production incident (2026-02-19) exposed two edge cases that caused prolonged SLO breaches during a regional capacity spike: (1) circuit breaker state machine race allowed transient errors to accumulate without tripping; (2) regional failover policy ignored short-term capacity signals causing routing to a saturated region. This hotfix tightens SLO enforcement, fixes the breaker race, adds a fast-path load-shedding policy for overloaded workers, and makes regional failover triggers responsive to smoothed capacity metrics. Changes include runtime fixes, a new unit/integration test suite for breaker/failover behavior, and observability updates (metrics, traces, dashboards). Backported to release-2026-02. Verification steps: run nightly canary load, run new integration scenarios, validate dashboards for expected fallback behavior; rollback plan: revert the squash merge and redeploy previous release; related: ENG-4821, ENG-4890, SUP-1532.
commits: fix(breaker): add atomic transition on 'half-open' -> 'open' to avoid double-accept race
feat(runtime): implement short-window capacity smoothing for regional routing decision
feat(runtime): add fast-path load-shedding rule when backend queue length > threshold
test: add integration tests for circuit breaker + regional failover under synthetic spike
docs: add runbook entries for breaker tripping and manual failover verification
review_comments: Miguel Garcia: Can you add a short unit test around the atomic transition? I want to ensure we don't regress under concurrent acceptance paths.
Ava Thompson: Added test_breaker_concurrency in the integration suite and validated locally with stress harness; pushed as part of commit 3.
Priya Patel: Verified telemetry changes and dashboard panels; LGTM assuming CI passes.
Liam O'Connor: Recommend adding a feature flag for the new smoothing window so we can ramp in case of unexpected behavior. Ava: added runtime flag 'regional_capacity_smoothing' with safe default.
release_notes: Hotfix: Prevent SLO breaches by enforcing circuit breaker transitions, adding fast-path load shedding, and improving regional failover responsiveness to capacity signals. Backported to release-2026-02.
